name: anim_dobe_idle
subject: a huge muscular Doberman monster made of thick glossy pink paint goo with yellow marble streaks, very broad chest, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Idle loop: slow heavy breathing, the very broad soft chest swells and settles, shoulders roll slightly, the gooey body sways a little and sags, drool slowly stretches and drips, the puddle base ripples. Stays in place. The face keeps the same sly closed-mouth smirk. Thick, sticky, viscous goo.
